title: The Gloria Tornado
subtitle: A memory from the backseat
quote: My family is living in a small Texas town, and I’m 6 years old.
label: From the essay
alt_text: A tilted cream photo print with the line: My family is living in a small Texas town, and I’m 6 years old. Below: The Gloria Tornado. Not Plain.

captions.instagram:
“My family is living in a small Texas town, and I’m 6 years old.”

My dad is at work and my sister is out of town, so it's just my mom, my baby brother and me, on our way to the zoo. What I remember most is holding his soft, shaking hand and whispering that everything was okay.

From The Gloria Tornado, on Not Plain. Read it at the link in bio.
